user.title: Connect to pi (va-bridge)
user.description: In pi on the machine where it lives, run /va-bridge setup and /va-bridge start, then enter the address and token it shows.

data_description.api_token: The PI_BRIDGE_TOKEN the bridge was started with

reauth_confirm.title: New bridge token
reauth_confirm.description: The pi bridge at {url} rejected the token.

data.detach_message: Message when a task continues in the background
data.busy_message: Message when pi is still busy
data.failed_message: Message when a background task fails
data.noise_filter: Ignore background speech after a false wake-up
data.workspace: Working directory on the pi host

data_description.prompt: Added to pi's system prompt (templates allowed). pi's own AGENTS.md, skills and extensions are always used.
data_description.reply_budget: If pi is still working after this long, it says the background message and announces the answer on the same voice device when done.
data_description.reset_hours: Only for one session per device: how long it must be quiet before pi starts a new session.
data_description.workspace: Leave empty to use the bridge's PI_BRIDGE_CWD.
data_description.failed_message: Announced when a background task fails, is stopped for taking too long, or gets lost. {error} is replaced by the reason (e.g. "Sorry, that failed: {error}"); the reason is always in the debug log.
data_description.noise_filter: Wake words also fire on the TV or radio. Voice devices then first check whether what was heard after the wake word was meant for the assistant. If not, the assistant makes a remark about it and asks; if the answer is background noise too, it stops listening without a word. ESPHome devices need a fresh conversation per wake word (and a pi_agent_dismiss action to also end their own chat mode).
data_description.debug: Log every text to and from pi (what was heard, pi's replies, tool calls, background results) in the Home Assistant log and the logbook.
data_description.announce: Spoken on the voice device in the voice of the assistant that uses pi. ESPHome devices with a pi_agent_working action show that pi is working meanwhile.

options.per_conversation: New pi session for every conversation
options.per_device: One ongoing pi session per device
